Genuine & Aftermarket Auto Parts Distributor

Request a Quote What We Do

Parts + Parcel Pte Ltd is a Singapore-based supplier and distributor of passenger car automotive parts, serving customers locally and across international markets.

We source and supply a comprehensive range of GENUINE, OEM and quality aftermarket parts for a wide variety of vehicle makes and models. Through our industry knowledge, dependable sourcing network, and established supplier relationships, we help customers identify and obtain the right components for their vehicle requirements.

Our commitment: Quality products, responsive service, and supply solutions you can count on.

What We Do

01

Genuine Parts

Factory-original components sourced through authorised channels for GENUINE parts.

02

OEM Parts

Components made by the same manufacturers who supply parts to vehicle assembly lines — same specifications, same fit.

03

Aftermarket Parts

Quality-checked alternatives for models and parts where GENUINE stock runs low or costs more than it needs to.

04

Export & Distribution

Supply to local and overseas market.

Frequently Asked Questions

What services do you offer?+

We supply Genuine OEM and quality aftermarket automotive parts for Toyota, Honda, Nissan, Mazda, Hyundai, Kia, Mitsubishi and BYD vehicles, serving both local and export customers. This includes sourcing, bulk supply, and shipping arrangements for wholesalers, workshops, and distributors.

How do I get started?+

Send us an enquiry list with the vehicle brand and part number you need. We'll get back to you with pricing and availability.

How can I contact you?+

Email us at sales@partsplusparcel.com and we'll get back to you with pricing and availability.
